title: Little Red Riding Hood: Easy English Story (A1)
description: Read the full text of Little Red Riding Hood at level A1. Tap a word for its meaning. A free easy English story for you, about 3 minutes.
intro: A girl takes food to her ill grandmother through the forest, but a hungry wolf meets her on the way. The sentences are short, the words are simple, and most of the story uses the past simple, so it suits A1 readers.
